applies_why: This judge text states DEFENDER WINS and relies on a retracted challenge-standing reason, so it is the RESULT rule's subject.
quote: The BROKEN grade is retracted because in (DR3) LINK 3 the challenger answered the pressed verses Matthew 1:18 and Matthew 1:25 with "dates the finding" and "bounds the stated abstinence," so the witness was not left unanswered under the counting rule.
rule_words: HELD gives DEFENDER WINS only if CHALLENGE STANDING is not SELF-SUPPORTED or at least one collision is graded CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN. A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count.
room: A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count — whether the retracted C3 broken grade is the standing's stated reason (so the standing does not count) or only a separate collision grade (so it could still count).
why: The judge’s only stated basis for DEFENDER WINS is a standing whose reason (C3 broken) was expressly retracted, and no unretracted CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN remains.
